name: sclinter-monorepo
description: Repositorio único: motor de detección (core), CLI, y extensión de VS Code. Ver README.md antes de tocar nada.

scripts.test:cli: npm run build:core && npm run build:cli && node packages/cli/out/bin/check.js
scripts.build:extension: npm run build:core && npm run sync:extension && npm run build --workspace=packages/vscode-extension
scripts.package:extension: npm run build:extension && npm run package --workspace=packages/vscode-extension
scripts.test:regression: npm run build:core && npm run build:cli && node scripts/run-regression.js
